ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) surface with approximately 5-8% high-intensity (white) pixel coverage localized in discrete spots.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary black background (#000000) with numerous high-contrast white (#FFFFFF) circular and ring-like spots (rosettes) scattered semi-uniformly. A high-density white pixel cluster is localized on the upper-left distal tip.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-shaped depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 42 degrees and a depth-to-width ratio of 1:1.2 relative to the lobe junction.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular serrations observed along the entire trailing edge; left lobe displays high-frequency sharp peaks (3-7 pixel amplitude); right lobe displays a more undulating, scalloped pattern with a significant secondary notch near the distal tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bilateral convex upward curve originating from the median notch, terminating at sharp superior-pointing distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Widespread detection of circular white ring structures (scars) ranging from 5 to 20 pixels in diameter across both lobes; highest concentration on the superior-lateral quadrant of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Two distinct vertical parallel white linear marks (rake marks) at approximately 30% width on the left lobe; additional faint diagonal linear disruptions on the mid-right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular tissue loss/notching on the superior edge of the left distal tip; multiple circular depigmented scars consistent with parasitic attachment sites.
other_distinctive_markers: White calcareous protrusions (barnacles) are visible on the far left edge of the fluke tip.
